title: ADR with empty aiAlignmentRules array
context: An ADR that records no AI alignment rules.
decision: Test that an empty aiAlignmentRules array is rejected.
consequences: AI drift cannot be constrained without alignment rules.
invariants: aiAlignmentRules must contain at least one rule.
forbiddenDrift: Do not record an ADR without AI alignment rules.
permittedChanges: AI alignment rules may be added by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: aiAlignmentRules is empty, violating minItems 1.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because aiAlignmentRules is empty.
